prompt_text: Who is the best property management company in St. Charles MO for a rental home?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” company, but **Eaton Properties** looks like a strong first call for a rental home in St. Charles: it has a local office, says it has about 40 years of experience in the St. Louis and St. Charles County area, and offers leasing, management, and maintenance. Call **636-939-3808**. [Eaton Properties](https://www.eatonproperties.com/)

I’d compare it with **Real Property Management Endeavor**, which specifically serves St. Charles County and lists tenant screening, leasing, rent collection, and maintenance. [RPM Endeavor](https://www.rpmendeavor.com/areas-we-serve/st-charles-county/saint-charles) · **636-244-5959**

Before choosing, ask each for a written fee schedule and sample management agreement. Compare the monthly fee, leasing and renewal fees, maintenance markups, inspection frequency, cancellation terms, and how quickly they respond to owner and tenant issues.
